description: Find private seniors' residences (RPA) on the island of Montréal from Québec's official register, filtered by place, needs, category or name. Returns each residence's address, phone, category, key services, register record and, when there is one, a guide page on residences-montreal.com.

area.description: Neighbourhood, borough or city on the island of Montréal, or a postal code start (e.g. 'Ahuntsic', 'Rosemont', 'Pointe-Claire', 'H2M'). Leave empty for the whole island.
area.title: Area

categories.description: RPA categories to include (1-2: independent seniors; 3: semi-independent; 4: moderate to severe loss of autonomy).
categories.title: Categories

limit.description: Maximum number of residences to return.
limit.title: Limit

needs.description: Services or features the residence must have, as declared in the register: nursing_care (nurses on staff); personal_assistance (help with hygiene, dressing, bathing...); medication_administration (staff give medication); accepts_wandering_risk (the residence says it takes residents who wander or may leave unnoticed; relevant for dementia, but not proof of a specialised memory-care unit); exit_alarm (alarm when a resident leaves); meals; housekeeping; elevator; air_conditioning_in_units; full_sprinklers; generator; non_profit (operator).
needs.title: Needs

name: search_residences
title: Search Montréal seniors' residences
